newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt to review business programmes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt to review business programmes.

text.p: Australian Industry Minister John Moore announced on Friday a review of the government's business assistance programmes.
Moore said the review would help the government to develop a strategic approach to the provision of industry assistance.
"It will assist the government to develop an industry policy framework as a basis for strong and sustained economic and employment growth," he said.
Moore said the review would be conducted in close consultation with industry groups. The review was not aimed at cutting back business programmes, he said.
"I believe the review will develop recommendations that ensure the government can meet its aim of providing effective programmes which allow industry to perform at its best," he said in a statement.
TNT Ltd chief executive David Mortimer will lead the review, assisted by ANZ Securities Corporate director Michael Lawriwsky.
Mortimer is scheduled to provide an interim report to the government in March next year with a final report expected by the end of June.
